faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.excerpt: We believe great experiences come from clarity. Here are answers to some of the most common questions to help you navigate Sam Global with ease.

points.title: How do I place an order?
points.description: Browse through our collections, select your preferred products, and proceed to checkout. The process is designed to be simple, seamless, and secure.

points.title: How can I track my order?
points.description: Once your order is confirmed, you will receive tracking details so you can monitor your delivery in real time.

points.title: Can I modify or cancel my order?
points.description: Orders can be modified or canceled within a limited time window after placement. We recommend acting promptly or reaching out to our support team for assistance.

points.title: What are the delivery timelines?
points.description: Delivery timelines may vary based on your location and product availability. Estimated timelines will be shared at checkout.

points.title: Do you offer free shipping?
points.description: Shipping benefits may vary depending on ongoing offers, order value, or location. Applicable details will be visible during checkout.

points.title: What is your return policy?
points.description: We offer a hassle-free return process within the specified return period, provided the product is unused and in its original condition.

points.title: How are refunds processed?
points.description: Refunds are initiated after product verification and processed to the original payment method within standard timelines.

points.title: What payment methods are accepted?
points.description: We support a range of secure payment options, including cards, UPI, net banking, and digital wallets.

points.title: Is it safe to make payments on your platform?
points.description: Yes, all transactions are secured through trusted payment gateways to ensure a safe and reliable experience.

points.title: Do I need an account to shop?
points.description: While you can browse freely, creating an account allows for a more personalized and seamless shopping experience.

points.title: How can I contact customer support?
points.description: You can reach out to us through the Contact Us page. Our team is always ready to assist you.

points.title: How can brands partner with Sam Global?
points.description: We collaborate with brands looking to expand through a structured and scalable retail platform. You can connect with us through our business inquiry channels.

points.title: Do you offer retail expansion opportunities?
points.description: Yes, we actively work with partners to expand our retail presence across key markets through a disciplined, growth-focused approach.

sections.title: Designed for Convenience. Delivered with Care.

points.title: Order Processing

Orders are processed within standard business timelines after successful payment confirmation
Processing timelines may vary based on product availability, order volume, or operational factors
Sam Global reserves the right to cancel or delay orders in case of unforeseen circumstances, including stock unavailability or verification issues

points.title: Delivery Timelines

Actual delivery may vary depending on location, logistics partner timelines, and external factors
Delays caused by circumstances beyond our control (including but not limited to weather, strikes, regional restrictions, or logistics disruptions) shall not constitute a breach of obligation

sections.description: This Return & Refund Policy governs the conditions under which returns, exchanges, and refunds are processed.

points.title: Return Eligibility
points.description:
Returns will be accepted only if:
The return request is initiated within the specified return window
The product is unused, undamaged, and in its original condition
All original tags, packaging, and accessories are intact
Sam Global reserves the right to reject returns that do not meet the above conditions.

points.title: Return Process
points.description:
Return requests must be initiated through the designated platform or support channels
Pickup or return instructions will be communicated upon request approval
Products must be handed over in the same condition as received
Failure to comply may result in rejection of the return request.

points.title: Verification & Approval
points.description:
All returned products are subject to inspection and quality checks
Approval or rejection of returns shall be at the sole discretion of Sam Global based on product condition

points.title: Refund Process
points.description:
Refunds will be initiated only after successful verification of returned products
Refunds will be processed via the original mode of payment unless otherwise specified
Timelines may vary depending on banking partners and payment gateways
Sam Global shall not be liable for delays caused by third-party financial institutions.

points.title: Exchange Policy
points.description:
Exchanges are subject to product availability and eligibility
In cases where exchange is not possible, a refund may be issued as per policy

points.title: Non-Returnable Items
points.description:
Certain products may not be eligible for return, including but not limited to:
Personal use or hygiene-sensitive items
Products marked as non-returnable at the time of purchase

points.title: Damaged / Incorrect Products
points.description:
Any claims regarding damaged, defective, or incorrect products must be reported within 48 hours of delivery
Failure to report within this timeframe may result in rejection of the claim

points.title: Cancellation Policy
points.description:
Orders can be cancelled only within a limited time window before dispatch
Once dispatched, orders cannot be cancelled and will be treated under the return policy

points.title: Limitation of Liability
points.description:
Sam Global shall not be liable for:
Improper use or handling of products after delivery
Minor variations in color, texture, or finish due to display differences
Delays in refunds caused by external financial systems

points.title: Need Help?
points.description:
For assistance, please reach out to our support team.
Clarity in process. Confidence in every purchase.
